title: Dell founder shows how a $100 billion empire started 42 years ago CEO says This one page changed my life
summary: Billionaire Michael Dell reminisced about the early days of his company, sharing an early quarterly earnings report that showed the then-startup making nearly $135,000 in just three months. Dell says that that document changed his life, as it convinced his parents that he no longer needed to go back to college and pursue his degree.

title: 'Nozzlegate' erupts as Prusa CORE One 3D printer kits arrive with soft steel nozzles Bondtech admits machining flaws with no quick fix

title: Play games with your brain signals using Octopus 16 wireless EEG device
summary: Octopus 16 is a wireless biosignal HID device for the XIAO ESP32-S3 board designed to let users play computer games using brain signals (EEG) with no hands (or implants) needed. The board packs 16 electrodes to measure biosignals, including EEG (electroencephalography), EMG (electromyography), and ECG (electrocardiography), and the coin-sized device is much more compact than other brain-computer interface (BCI) solutions, which typically require a cap kit with 8 to 16 electrodes and wires.
